title: Graphs that are not 2-connected are nonhamiltonian
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on at least three vertices, and suppose its vertex connectivity satisfies $\kappa(G) < 2$ (equivalently, $G$ is not $2$-connected). Then $G$ is nonhamiltonian; that is, $G$ has no Hamiltonian cycle.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
vertex connectivity is less than 2 ($\kappa(G) < 2$, i.e. not 2-connected)
replaced:
4.2.1 Show that if either

(a) $G$ is not 2-connected, or
(b) $G$ is bipartite with bipartition $(X, Y)$ where $|X| \neq |Y|$,
then $G$ is nonhamiltonian.
